gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-sans-zanabaza: Noto Sans Zanabazar Square has wide gaps and a soaring x-height that keep small sizes crisp. But Quantum's strokes stay blunt with no tapering, so the body text can shrink without fuss.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-traditional-n: Crisp, techy lines up top, then a friendly brushed stroke below. Quantum draws uninterrupted monoline strokes, while Noto Traditional Nushu swings a broad-nibbed pen whose bowls fill the line.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-numans: Clean and techy up top, Quantum hands off to Numans, whose s hangs its ends far from the spine. And the heading's constant stroke gives that tightly coiled, widely tracked lowercase a straight-edged frame.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-oxygen: Ruler-straight Quantum sits loose up top, with Oxygen below keeping its curves open and lowercase nearly matching capitals. Straight weight meets open curves, and that tension is the draw.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-parkinsans: Modern through and through, Quantum leads while Parkinsans follows behind. Down a full page, Parkinsans holds a single stroke thickness and wide-mouthed letters that stay crisp when shrunk, so text flows smoothly.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Wire-smooth Quantum glides across the top, while Schibsted Grotesk below brings tall bowls and terminals that never close in. Wire-like lines above, generous shapes below, and the page moves easily.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-sulphur-point: Quantum arrives loose, techy and spacious, with ascenders compressed short. The heading is best at spacious display letterfit, while Sulphur Point is best at distinct open gaps and a steady marker-like line.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-tiktok-sans: TikTok Sans lifts its x-height close to cap height and gives the c a spacious opening beside loose, techy Quantum. Shrink the heading and its pipe-cleaner strokes may grow faint.
